# Support

CI Radar is community-supported open-source software and does not imply a response-time or availability SLA.

Use GitHub issues for reproducible defects and focused feature requests. Use discussions or project documentation for general usage questions when those channels are available.

Remove secrets, private identifiers, customer data, and internal repository names before sharing logs or configuration.

Security vulnerabilities should follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and should not be reported in a public issue.
